name: SuperFile
note: Rating note: title partner of Trackhouse MotoGP since June 2026 — multi-year naming-rights deal; the team races as SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team (club press release, 2026-06-05, via Wayback Machine; SportsMint Media, 2026-06-10). SuperFile's logos are on the bike bodywork and riders' race suits from the 2026 Hungarian GP. SuperFile Inc. is a private Chicago-based digital file-security company founded and led by Shane Valdez (Founder & CEO, per the club press release). No shareholder register or investor list found (checked 2026-10-03), so an owner cannot be named and the sponsor stays not rated yet; if 'founder & CEO' of a private startup counts as the named owner, propose none.
